paragraphs: EnSoftek sells DrCloudEHR, an electronic health record the company says is built exclusively for behavioral health. It pairs clinical workflow management with revenue cycle automation and AI-assisted documentation in a single platform.

The record handles scheduling, documentation, treatment planning, ePrescribing, eMAR, group therapy, and telehealth. On the billing side, the company says it automates coding, claim submission, denial prevention, and cash flow. A scribe tool listens during patient encounters and drafts structured SOAP notes.

EnSoftek dates its founding to 2001 and says it has served more than 170 organizations nationwide. It lists headquarters in Oregon with regional offices in Chicago, Washington, DC, and India. More than 70 staff members work on developing, implementing, and supporting healthcare software. The company also states that it achieved Meaningful Use Stage 3 Promoting Interoperability certification. It sells to government buyers as well, describing itself as a managed services firm serving federal, state and local agencies.

quote.text: DrCloudEHR is an intelligent EHR built exclusively for behavioral health
